endpoints.name: GetPromptsAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves all AI prompts with advanced filtering, pagination, search capabilities, and access control for prompt management. This endpoint supports advanced search criteria. To use advanced search, provide a JSON array of `searchCriteria` objects in the request body. Each object should have `field`, `operator`, and `value` properties. Supported fields for search include: `Name`, `Description`, `Prompt`, `Type`, `PromptFunction`, `Project`, `Location`, `Model`, `CreatedAt`. Supported operators are: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `between`. For date fields like `CreatedAt`, use `between` with a comma-separated date range (e.g., '2023-01-01,2023-12-31').

request.description: AI prompt filter request containing search and pagination parameters

example_uses: Find prompts containing 'email' in the name
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to search, list, filter, or browse AI prompts and prompt templates.

endpoints.name: GetPromptByIdAsync
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific AI prompt by ID with complete details including prompt content, parameters, and configuration.
example_uses: Show me details for AI prompt ID 123
Show prompt with all parameters and content
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific AI prompt details by ID or when you need complete prompt information for editing or testing.

endpoints.name: CreatePromptAsync
endpoints.description: Creates a new AI prompt with complete configuration including content, parameters, model settings, and metadata.

model.description: AI prompt creation request with all configuration details

example_uses: Create a new email generation prompt
Add a customer service response template
Set up a new data analysis prompt
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to create, add, or set up a new AI prompt template.

endpoints.name: UpdatePromptAsync

example_uses: Update prompt 123's content with new template

endpoints.name: DeletePromptAsync

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or eliminate an AI prompt.

endpoints.description: Upgrades all AI prompts to use the latest available Gemini model.

Initiate a system-wide Gemini model upgrade.
Update the AI models used by all prompts.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to update all existing AI prompts to utilize the latest version of the Gemini model.

endpoints.name: GetUserSessions

example_uses: Get my AI assistant chat history.
Show me my past conversations with the AI assistant.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you want to view a list of all chat sessions you've had with the AI assistant.

endpoints.name: GetSessionDetails

example_uses: Retrieve the chat log for session 'abc-def'.

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to access the full conversation history and details of a particular AI assistant session.

endpoints.name: ChatWithGemini

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to send messages, files, or extracted text to the Gemini AI assistant and receive a response, either starting a new session or continuing an existing one.

endpoints.name: ProcessDataRelatedSummaryDetails
endpoints.description: Processes specific data to generate summary details, requiring an ID and optionally a type and message.
example_uses: Process data with ID 123 for summary.
Generate a summary for data type 'report' with ID 456.
Process data with ID 789 and include a custom message.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this to trigger the processing of specific data identified by an ID, to obtain summary details.

endpoints.name: UpdateAiAssistantAccessibility

example_uses: Enable text-to-speech for my current AI session.
Update text-to-speech setting for AI assistant.

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionStar

endpoints.name: UpdateSessionArchive

example_uses: Archive my current AI assistant session.

endpoints.name: GenerateAndStoreEmbeddings

entityName.description: The name of the entity for which to generate embeddings (e.g., 'Partner', 'Contact').

example_uses: Generate embeddings for all partner data.

Can you trigger the embedding generation process for the system?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to initiate the process of generating and storing AI embeddings for various data entities, which can then be used for AI search or similarity tasks.

endpoints.name: GenerateTitle

sessionId.description: The ID of the AI assistant session to generate a title for.

example_uses: Generate a title for the current AI chat session.
I need a summary title for session 'abc-123'.
Can the AI suggest a title for my ongoing conversation?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to leverage AI to automatically generate a suitable title for an ongoing or completed AI assistant session, useful for organizing conversations.

endpoints.name: GenerateSuggestions
endpoints.description: Generates AI-powered suggestions, such as follow-up questions or related topics, for the AI assistant.
example_uses: Provide me with some AI-generated suggestions for my next steps.
What are some related topics the AI can suggest?
Can the AI assistant give me some follow-up questions?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get AI-driven suggestions, like potential next questions or related discussion points, to enhance user interaction with the AI assistant.
